responsibility: Defines the ISO random-access file channel interface. It declares open operations for existing or freshly cleaned random files, predicates and exceptions for validating random-file channels, the FilePos type and routines for start/current/end position queries, position arithmetic and seeking, and channel closure, making it the public random-file device API layered on the gm2 channel subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the specification surface for the random-access file module: it publishes the channel types, flag constants, FilePos API, and open/seek/close procedures. It differs from RndFile.mod, which contains the actual device implementation on top of RTgen/RTio/FIO and raises runtime exceptions when operations are misused.
